description: Roll out an LLM gateway (LiteLLM/Kong AI) in front of OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Must: deploy gateway with API key management, configure rate limiting per consumer (100 req/min), set up canary routing (90% GPT-4o-mini, 10% Claude for A/B testing), configure model routing rules (cheapest model that meets quality bar), deploy monitoring (token usage, latency, error rate), and verify failover to backup provider. Risk factors: rate limiting too strict blocking legitimate traffic, model routing choosing wrong model, API key leakage, latency from gateway hop. Tools available: LiteLLM, Kong, Helm, kubectl, OpenAI API.
